title: 한국식 영어 읽기: 핸드폰, 셀카, 노트북
objective: You can read 핸드폰, 셀카, 노트북, 서비스, 사인 and 헬스 aloud and know their Korean meanings.
summary: Read six everyday Korean words from English that mean something different in Korean.

task.title: Read, choose and write
task.line: Read each item aloud first, then choose, fill in, or write the sound in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: What is your cell phone number?
I do my homework on my laptop.

words.meaning: something free from a shop, on the house
words.exampleMeaning: This drink is on the house.
I work out at the gym every day.

letters.as: English f becomes ㅍ: phone → 폰, so 핸드폰 [핸드폰].
The last consonant slides into the next ㅇ: 노트북을 → [노트부글].

exercises: Choose the word that matches the meaning: ① a laptop computer (노트북 / 노트) ② a free extra from a shop (서비스 / 사인) ③ a photo you take of yourself (셀카 / 카메라)
Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 핸드폰이 ② 사인을 ③ 노트북에
Fill in the blank with 서비스, 사인 or 헬스: ① 카페 직원: 이 쿠키는 ____예요. ② 은행 직원: 이름 옆에 ____해 주세요. ③ A: 저녁에 운동해요? B: 네, 저는 ____해요.
Write O (true) or X (false): ① 노트북 is a small paper notebook. ② 셀카 is a photo of yourself. ③ 사인 is a sign on the road. ④ 핸드폰 is a mobile phone.
answers: ① 노트북 ② 서비스 ③ 셀카
① 서비스 ② 사인 ③ 헬스
① X ② O ③ X ④ O
